data.description:
# Mutation gate has no "change predates the gate" guard, so it hard-fails older changes

The bounded mutation gate runs its reusable workflow from `refs/heads/main` but executes
it against the CHECKED-OUT PATCHSET tree. When a change is based on a commit older than
the one that introduced `scripts/mutation_gate.py`, the script is absent from that tree and
the step dies:

    /home/runner/work/rebar/rebar/.venv/bin/python3: can't open file
    '/home/runner/work/rebar/rebar/scripts/mutation_gate.py': [Errno 2] No such file or directory
    ##[error]Process completed with exit code 2.

The result is a `Verified -1` that says nothing about the change's own quality.

## Evidence

Two consecutive runs, both failing pre-analysis, on changes based on `c0bb6dcc` (which
predates the walking-skeleton commit `57d19254` that added the script):

- change 1621 patchset 1 — run 31561319537, job 94004044... exit code 2
- change 1624 patchset 1 — run 31561579063, job 94005317237, exit code 2

On 1624 the checkout step itself SUCCEEDED ("Checkout the Gerrit patchset ✓"); the failure
is in "Run changed mutation shards", so this is not a fetch race. It is deterministic for
any change whose base predates the script.

## Why this is the gate's bug, not the author's

Every sibling gate in the same workflow already guards for exactly this, and skips with an
explanatory message rather than failing. For example the env-var registry gate:

    if [ ! -f scripts/gen_env_registry.py ]; then
      echo "scripts/gen_env_registry.py not in checked-out tree (change predates the gate) \
    — skipping; the gate re-enforces on rebase and on every post-merge change"
      exit 0
    fi

`scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py` carries the same guard. The mutation gate is the only
one missing it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The mutation gate skips cleanly (exit 0, explanatory message) when
      `scripts/mutation_gate.py` is absent from the checked-out tree, matching the wording
      and behaviour of the sibling gates.
- [ ] A change based before the walking-skeleton commit gets no `Verified -1` from this
      gate.
- [ ] A change based at or after it still runs the gate for real — the skip must not
      become a silent bypass on current changes.

## Workaround

Rebase the change onto current `origin/main`; the script then exists and the gate runs
(and correctly reports "no protected shard selected" for changes touching no shard).

## Provenance

Hit twice while landing the build-drift warning (`tasty-unappeased-leopard`,
b273-e0ba-f719-4f1c). Filed at operator direction so the mutation-testing work has the
signal.
data.title: Mutation gate hard-fails changes that predate its own script
